dpdk_initialized.description: Enable DPDK initialization in Open vSwitch. Required for DPDK-based forwarding.

dpdk_socket_mem.description: Comma-separated list of MB of memory to reserve on each NUMA node for DPDK. Example: '1024,1024' for two NUMA nodes.

dpdk_lcore_mask.description: Hexadecimal bitmask of CPU cores to use for DPDK lcore threads. Example: '0x3' uses cores 0 and 1.

dpdk_pmd_core_mask.description: Hexadecimal bitmask of CPU cores dedicated to DPDK poll-mode drivers (PMDs). Separate from lcore mask if needed.

dpdk_hugepages.description: Path to mounted DPDK hugepage filesystem. Must be mounted before OVS starts.

dpdk_nics.description: List of PCI addresses of NICs to be used by DPDK (e.g., '0000:01:00.0'). These will be bound to DPDK drivers and added as dpdk ports.

pci_addr.description: PCI address of the NIC (format: domain:bus:device.function)

interface_name.description: Desired name for the resulting OVS dpdk port

dpdk_rss_hash_functions.description: Comma-separated list of RSS hash functions to enable for DPDK ports.

dpdk_rx_queues.description: Number of RX queues per DPDK port.

dpdk_tx_queues.description: Number of TX queues per DPDK port.

dpdk_rx_desc.description: Number of RX descriptors per queue for DPDK ports.

dpdk_tx_desc.description: Number of TX descriptors per queue for DPDK ports.

dpdk_mempool_size.description: Number of mbufs per DPDK mempool (per port, per NUMA node).

ovs_bridge_name.description: Name of the main OVS bridge to create and configure.

ovs_bridge_type.description: Type of the main OVS bridge (typically 'system' for physical ports; use 'dpdk' only if DPDK bridge is explicitly needed).

external_ids.description: Key-value pairs to set as open_vswitch external_ids (e.g., 'system-id', 'hostname').

commands.description: List of low-level ovs-vsctl commands to generate config. Used for advanced customization beyond high-level fields.

description.description: Human-readable description of the command (for comments)

key.description: Config key to set or create

value.description: Value to assign (may be numeric or string, will be quoted as needed)

ports.description: List of port names for bridge ports (used in set-bridge-ports)
